mapper.select: -- 1、找到 win_ratio >= 50 的日期，然后再去看能否入手，看echart在底部 with tmp_69 as ( select t1.`_date` name , round(cnt_win/cnt_all * 100) value9 -- , case when round(cnt_win/cnt_all * 100) <= 75 then 0 else round(cnt_win/cnt_all * 100) end value9 , sum(case when `_direction` = 'S' and `_9_zhuan` in ('06', '07', '08', '09') then 1 when `_direction` = 'B' and `_9_zhuan` in ('06', '07', '08', '09') then -1 else 0 end) value10 -- , round(cnt_win/cnt_all * 100), cnt_all from t_eastmoney_node_9_zhuan t1, t_eastmoney_node_avg_statis tenas where t1.`_date` > '2025-01-01' and t1.`_date` = tenas .`_date` group by t1.`_date`, value9 order by 1 desc limit 250 ) , tmp_69_rank as ( select t.name , t.value9 , t.value10 , rank() over (order by t.value10) rank_ from tmp_69 t ) -- 2、找到目标日期 , target_days as ( select t.name today_date , t.value9 win_ratio , t.value10 today_value , t1.value10 limit_line , rank() over (order by t.name desc) date_rn from tmp_69_rank t , (select max(value10) value10 from tmp_69_rank where rank_ <= 250 * 0.2) t1 where t.value10 < t1.value10 * 1.2 -- 需要低于buy线 -- and t.value9 >= 50 -- win_ratio需要大于50 ) -- 3、测算sql , tmp_dates_000001 as ( select teni.date date_next_0 , lead(teni.`date` , 1) over (order by teni.`date` ) date_next_1 , lead(teni.`date` , 2) over (order by teni.`date` ) date_next_2 , lead(teni.`date` , 3) over (order by teni.`date` ) date_next_3 , lead(teni.`date` , 4) over (order by teni.`date` ) date_next_4 -- , lag(teni.`date` , 1) over (order by teni.`date` ) date_pre_1 from t_eastmoney_node_index teni where teni.`date` >= '2026-06-10' -- (select today_date from target_days where date_rn = 2) -- '2026-06-11' and teni.stockCode = '1.000001' ) , tmp_dates as ( select t1.* from tmp_dates_000001 t1, target_days t2 where date_rn <= 5 -- teni.`date` >= '2026-06-10' -- (select today_date from target_days) -- '2026-06-11' and t1.date_next_0 = t2.today_date ) -- select * from tmp_dates order by 1, 2; , tmp_ans as ( select tenr.stockCode , tenr.stockName , tenr.info , sum(case when ten.`date` = td.date_next_0 then last else 0 end) last , sum(case when ten.`date` between td.date_next_2 and ifnull(td.date_next_4, '9999') then chg else 0 end) should_win_chg -- , sum(case when ten.`date` >= td.date_next_1 then chg else 0 end) chg_t_plus -- , sum(case when ten.`date` >= td.date_next_0 then chg else 0 end) chg_t , sum(case when ten.`date` = td.date_next_0 then chg else 0 end) chg_next_0 , sum(case when ten.`date` = td.date_next_1 then chg else 0 end) chg_next_1 , sum(case when ten.`date` = td.date_next_2 then chg else 0 end) chg_next_2 , sum(case when ten.`date` = td.date_next_3 then chg else 0 end) chg_next_3 , sum(case when ten.`date` = td.date_next_4 then chg else 0 end) chg_next_4 , td.date_next_0, date_next_1, date_next_2, date_next_3, date_next_4 from t_eastmoney_node_right tenr , t_eastmoney_node ten , t_hs300 th, tmp_dates td where tenr.`date` = td.date_next_0 -- and ten.date <= '2026-06-15' -- and substring(tenr.stockName , 1, 2) >= '07' -- and ten.`date` < '3000' and ten.`date` >= td.date_next_0 and tenr.stockCode = th.stockCode and ten.stockCode = th.fullStockCode and tenr.info like '%222_223%' -- 多头排列 and tenr.info like '%225%' -- 大波动 -- and td.date_pre_1 is null group by td.date_next_0, tenr.stockCode , tenr.stockName, tenr.info , td.date_next_0, date_next_1, date_next_2, date_next_3, date_next_4 ) , tmp_today as (select max(date) date_ from t_eastmoney_node_index teni ) , tmp_max_date as (select today_date date_max_in_target_days from target_days where date_rn = 1) select stockCode , case when t3.date_max_in_target_days = date_next_0 then concat('*', date_next_0) when t2.date_ = date_next_0 then concat('**', date_next_0) else date_next_0 end date, stockName last , concat('should_win_chg=', round(should_win_chg, 1) , '; last=', round(last, 2) , '; chg=', round(chg_next_0, 1) , '; chg_next_1=', round(chg_next_1, 1) , '; chg_next_2=', round(chg_next_2, 1) , '; chg_next_3=', round(chg_next_3, 1) , '; chg_next_4=', round(chg_next_4, 1) , '; info=', info ) ratioB -- , info, should_win_chg, last, chg_next_0 chg , chg_next_1, chg_next_2, chg_next_3, chg_next_4 -- , concat(date_next_0, ': ', chg_next_0) chg_next_0 -- , concat(date_next_1, ': ', chg_next_1) chg_next_1 -- , concat(date_next_2, ': ', chg_next_2) chg_next_2 -- , concat(date_next_3, ': ', chg_next_3) chg_next_3 -- , concat(date_next_4, ': ', chg_next_4) chg_next_4 from tmp_ans t1, tmp_today t2, tmp_max_date t3 order by date_next_0 desc, 3 desc

with tmp_calc_dates as ( select date tc_date from t_eastmoney_node_index teni where stockCode = '1.000001' order by `date` desc limit 10 ) , tmp as ( select `date` , tc_date , lag(`date`, 1) over (partition by stockCode, tcd.tc_date order by ten.`date` ) date_pre_1 , lag(volume, 1) over (partition by stockCode, tcd.tc_date order by ten.`date` ) vol_pre_1 , lag(volume, 2) over (partition by stockCode, tcd.tc_date order by ten.`date` ) vol_pre_2 , volume , rank() over (partition by stockCode, tcd.tc_date order by ten.`date` desc) date_rank , last , chg , stockCode , lead(chg, 1) over (partition by stockCode, tcd.tc_date order by ten.`date` ) chg_next_1 , lead(chg, 2) over (partition by stockCode, tcd.tc_date order by ten.`date` ) chg_next_2 from t_eastmoney_node ten, tmp_calc_dates tcd where ten.`date` <= '2099' -- and stockCode = '0.002056' AND ten.`date` > DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(SYSDATE() , INTERVAL -60 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') and ten.stockCode not like '%.3%' and ten.stockCode not like '%.68%' and ten.stockCode not like '%.69%' AND ten.`date` <= tc_date ) -- select * from tmp where stockCode = '0.002025' order by 2 desc, 1 desc; -- 1)、成交量>前2天之和 , tmp_vol as ( select distinct tc_date, stockCode from tmp where volume > vol_pre_1 + vol_pre_2 and date_rank <= 3 ) -- 2)、5天内存在chg>5 , tmp_has_5_chg as ( select t.stockCode, tc_date, max(chg) chg_max from tmp t where t.date_rank <= 3 group by t.stockCode, tc_date having chg_max > 5 ) -- 3)、5、10、20多头 , tmp_30_duotou as ( select t1.date, t1.tc_date, t1.date_rank, t1.date_pre_1, t1.stockCode, t1.chg , max(t1.last) `last` , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank + 3 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.last, 4) else null end), 3) ma3 , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank + 6 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.last, 4) else null end), 3) ma6 , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank + 12 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.last, 4) else null end), 3) ma12 , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank + 24 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.last, 4) else null end), 3) ma24 -- 计算 bbi , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank + 5 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.last, 4) else null end), 3) ma5 , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank + 10 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.last, 4) else null end), 3) ma10 , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank + 20 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.last, 4) else null end), 3) ma20 -- 计算均线 , round(sum(case when t1.date_rank + 5 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.chg, 4) else 0 end), 3) chg_sum_5 -- , sum(case when t1.date_rank + 30 > t2.date_rank then 1 else 0 end) cnt_ from tmp t1, tmp t2 where t1.stockCode = t2.stockCode and t1.tc_date = t2.tc_date and t1.date_rank <= t2.date_rank -- and t1.date_rank <= 30 group by t1.date, t1.tc_date, t1.date_rank, t1.date_pre_1, t1.stockCode, t1.chg having max(t1.last) >= ma5 and ma5 >= ma10 * 0.98 and ma10 >= ma20 * 0.98 -- and cnt_ = 30 and chg_sum_5 > 10 ) -- select * from tmp_30_duotou where stockCode = '0.002056'; -- 4)、last 在bbi上方 select th.stockCode, t.date, concat(th.bkName, '-', th.stockName) last -- , concat('last:', t.last, '; ma5:', t.ma5, '; ma10:', t.ma10, '; ma20:', t.ma20, '; bbi:', round((t.ma3+t.ma6+t.ma12+t.ma24)/4, 3)) ratioB , concat('should_win_chg=', round(t3.chg_next_2, 1) , '; last=', round(t.last, 2) , '; chg=', round(t.chg, 1) , '; chg_next_1=', round(t3.chg_next_1, 1) , '; chg_next_2=', round(t3.chg_next_2, 1) , '; ma5=', round(t.ma5, 1) , '; ma10=', round(t.ma10, 1) , '; ma20=', round(t.ma20, 1) , '; bbi=', round((t.ma3+t.ma6+t.ma12+t.ma24)/4, 3) , '; info=', 'T+1买(T+2卖)' ) ratioB -- , t3.chg_next_1, t3.chg_next_2 -- , t.last, t.ma5, t.ma10, t.ma20 -- , round((t.ma3+t.ma6+t.ma12+t.ma24)/4, 3) bbi from tmp_30_duotou t, tmp_has_5_chg t1, tmp_vol t2, t_hs300 th, tmp t3 where t.date_rank = 1 and t.stockCode = t1.stockCode and t.tc_date = t1.tc_date and t.stockCode = t2.stockCode and t.tc_date = t2.tc_date and t.stockCode = th.fullStockCode and t.stockCode = t3.stockCode and t.date = t3.date and t3.tc_date = (select max(tc_date) from tmp_calc_dates) and t.last >= round((t.ma3+t.ma6+t.ma12+t.ma24)/4, 3) order by 2 desc, 1 desc

with tmp_codes as (select distinct fullStockCode from t_longtou) , tmp_rank as ( select ten.date, ten.chg, ten.stockCode, ten.`last` , rank() over (partition by ten.stockCode order by ten.`date` desc) date_rank from t_eastmoney_node ten, tmp_codes tc where ten.stockCode = tc.fullStockCode and ten.date < '2099-01-01' AND ten.`date` > DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(SYSDATE() , INTERVAL -90 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') ) -- select * from tmp_rank; , tmp_today as ( select * from tmp_duotou where date_rank <= 5 ) -- select * from tmp_today; , tmp_ans as ( select -- distinct tt.`date` , tlt.stockCode , tlt.stockName , tlt.bkName , tlt.ranking, tt.chg, tt.`last` -- , case when tt.last >= tt.ma5 and tt.ma5 > tt.ma10 * 0.98 and tt.ma10 > tt.ma20 * 0.98 then '多头排列' else '' end 'duo_tou' -- , tbk.chg_avg distinct tlt.stockCode, tbk.`date`, concat(tlt.bkName, '-', tlt.ranking, '-', tlt.stockName) last , concat('当天chg=', round(tt.chg, 2), '; ' , '板块avg-chg=', round(tbk.chg_avg, 1) , case when tt.last >= tt.ma5 and tt.ma5 >= tt.ma10 * 0.98 and tt.ma10 >= tt.ma20 * 0.98 then '多头排列' else '' end ) ratioB , tbk.chg_avg from tmp_today tt, t_longtou tlt , ( select date, bkName, round(avg(chg), 1) chg_avg from tmp_today t1, t_longtou tlt where t1.stockCode = tlt.fullStockCode group by date, tlt.bkName ) tbk where tt.stockCode = tlt.fullStockCode and tbk.bkName = tlt.bkName and tbk.date = tt.date order by tbk.date desc, tbk.chg_avg desc, concat(tlt.bkName, '-', tlt.ranking, '-', tlt.stockName) ) select stockCode, date, last, ratioB from tmp_ans;

with tmp_date_rank as ( select rank() over (order by `date` desc) date_rn, date from t_eastmoney_node_index teni where stockCode = '1.000001' -- and `date` < '2026-07-18' ) , tmp_ans as ( select lag(date, 1) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` ) pre_date , lag(volume, 1) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` ) pre_volume , lag(volume, 2) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` ) pre_volume_2 , lag(volume, 3) over (partition by ten.stockCode order by `date` ) pre_volume_3 , ten.* from t_eastmoney_node ten where ten.`date` > (select min(date) from tmp_date_rank where date_rn <=5) and ten.`date` < '2099' ) , tmp_long_shang_yin as ( select distinct ta.stockCode from tmp_ans ta where (ta.high - ta.last) > 2*abs(ta.last-ta.open) and abs(abs(ta.high-ta.low)/ta.last*100) > 6 ) , tmp_die_ting as ( select distinct ta.stockCode from tmp_ans ta where ta.chg < -9 ) -- select * from tmp_die_ting; , tmp_big_swing as ( select stockCode, avg(abs(chg)) avg_chg from tmp_ans group by stockCode having avg_chg > 2 ) , tmp_suo_liang as ( select distinct round(ta.volume/ta.pre_volume, 2) ratio , tl.stockCode , ta.pre_volume, ta.chg, ta.last, ta.volume, tl.bkName , tl.stockName, ta.date from tmp_ans ta, t_longtou tl, tmp_big_swing tgs where 1 = 1 and ta.date = (select max(date) from tmp_date_rank where date_rn = 1) and ta.stockCode = tl.fullStockCode and ta.chg > -9 and ta.chg < 9 and (round(ta.volume/ta.pre_volume, 2) <= 0.68 and ta.last < ta.open or round(ta.volume/ta.pre_volume_2, 2) <= 0.68 and ta.last < ta.open /*or round(ta.volume/ta.pre_volume_3, 2) <= 0.68*/) and ta.chg < 0 and not exists (select 1 from tmp_die_ting tdt where ta.stockCode = tdt.stockCode) and not exists (select 1 from tmp_long_shang_yin tdt where ta.stockCode = tdt.stockCode) and tl.stockCode not like '3%' and tl.stockCode not like '68%' and tl.stockCode not like '69%' and ta.stockCode = tgs.stockCode ) , tmp_ready as ( select t.ratio, t.stockCode, t.pre_volume, t.volume, t.chg, t.last, th.stockName, group_concat(t.bkName) bkName_multi, t.date from tmp_suo_liang t, t_hs300 th where t.stockCode = th.stockCode group by t.ratio, t.stockCode, t.pre_volume, t.volume, t.chg, t.last, th.stockName, t.date ) select t.stockCode, t.date, concat(t.bkName_multi, '-', t.stockName) last , concat('suo-liang-ratio=', t.ratio, '; pre-vol=', t.pre_volume, '; vol=', t.volume, '; last=', t.last, '; chg=', t.chg) ratioB from tmp_ready t , ( with tmp_codes as (select distinct fullStockCode from t_longtou) , tmp_rank as ( select ten.date, ten.chg, ten.stockCode, ten.`last` , rank() over (partition by ten.stockCode order by ten.`date` desc) date_rank from t_eastmoney_node ten, tmp_codes tc where ten.stockCode = tc.fullStockCode and ten.date < '2099-01-01' -- and `date` < '2026-07-18' AND ten.`date` > DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(SYSDATE() , INTERVAL -90 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') ) -- select * from tmp_rank; , tmp_duotou as ( select t1.date, t1.date_rank, t1.stockCode, t1.chg, t1.last -- , max(t1.last) `last` , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank + 5 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.last, 4) else null end), 3) ma5 , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank + 10 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.last, 4) else null end), 3) ma10 , round(avg(case when t1.date_rank + 20 > t2.date_rank then round(t2.last, 4) else null end), 3) ma20 -- 计算均线 -- , sum(case when t1.date_rank + 20 > t2.date_rank then 1 else 0 end) ma_cnt -- 计算均线天数 from tmp_rank t1, tmp_rank t2 where t1.stockCode = t2.stockCode and t1.date_rank <= t2.date_rank group by t1.date, t1.date_rank, t1.stockCode, t1.chg, t1.last -- having ma5 >= ma10 and ma10 >= ma20 ) -- select * from tmp_30_duotou; , tmp_today as ( select * from tmp_duotou where date_rank <= 5 ) -- select * from tmp_today; , tmp_ans as ( select -- distinct tt.`date` , tlt.stockCode , tlt.stockName , tlt.bkName , tlt.ranking, tt.chg, tt.`last` -- , case when tt.last >= tt.ma5 and tt.ma5 > tt.ma10 * 0.98 and tt.ma10 > tt.ma20 * 0.98 then '多头排列' else '' end 'duo_tou' -- , tbk.chg_avg distinct tlt.stockCode, tbk.`date`, concat(tlt.bkName, '-', tlt.ranking, '-', tlt.stockName) last , concat('当天chg=', round(tt.chg, 2), '; ' , '板块avg-chg=', round(tbk.chg_avg, 1) , case when tt.last >= tt.ma5 and tt.ma5 >= tt.ma10 * 0.98 and tt.ma10 >= tt.ma20 * 0.98 then '多头排列' else '' end ) ratioB , tbk.chg_avg from tmp_today tt, t_longtou tlt , ( select date, bkName, round(avg(chg), 1) chg_avg from tmp_today t1, t_longtou tlt where t1.stockCode = tlt.fullStockCode group by date, tlt.bkName ) tbk where tt.stockCode = tlt.fullStockCode and tbk.bkName = tlt.bkName and tbk.date = tt.date and tt.last >= tt.ma5 and tt.ma5 >= tt.ma10 * 0.98 and tt.ma10 >= tt.ma20 * 0.98 order by tbk.date desc, tbk.chg_avg desc, concat(tlt.bkName, '-', tlt.ranking, '-', tlt.stockName) ) select distinct stockCode -- , date, last, ratioB from tmp_ans ) t1 where t.stockCode = t1.stockCode order by t.ratio, 3;
